FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Store message and append destination only when state1 and not already ready. Existing occupied slot is overwritten without incrementing occupied count. No task switch inside this trap.

FUNCTION.NAME: message_post_priority
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: TRAPA 0x22: post r11, then queue a destination in state 1 or 4 at the head its class byte names, bit 7 the first head.

FUNCTION.NAME: task_requeue_current
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Append current record to its ID-selected ready queue, mark state 4, select and dispatch. Requires an existing full context at record +8. The ready link is not cleared before append.

FUNCTION.NAME: task_initialize
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Unchecked task ID in r1. Initialize record, optional PC/SR frame and descriptor-selected clear range. A null stack leaves saved SP untouched.

FUNCTION.NAME: task_select_ready
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: First nonempty of twelve head words 0x0f0001d8..0x0f000204. Pop head, clear record +16, return record in r12/r13 and r0=0. r10 survives. Empty queues invoke diagnostic TRAPA 0x2b.

FUNCTION.NAME: task_dispatch
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Use signed record state as index into 0x1358. Mark state 5, clear +6, publish current record, switch SP in JMP delay slot. State 4 restores a full context, states 0/3/5/6 only PC/SR.

FUNCTION.NAME: task_resume_message
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: State-1 dispatch reads an optional per-task PC at 0x09075800 + 4*ID, consumes a mailbox word into r11, then RTEs to the original or replaced PC.

FUNCTION.NAME: task_restore_reply
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Dispatch for state 2: r12 and r13 from +24 and +28, the first two mailbox words, cleared, then PC and SR.

FUNCTION.NAME: task_restore_context
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 80-byte frame: MACL, MACH, GBR, PR, r13..r0, PC, SR. Record +8 advances to post-return SP. r14 and VBR are not restored.

FUNCTION.NAME: task_return_exception
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Restore PC/SR and consume eight bytes. Record +8 is unchanged. No general registers, PR, GBR, MACH or MACL are restored. Their values come from the intervening execution path.

FUNCTION.NAME: message_store
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Destination high byte and source/class second byte select unchecked tables. Class bit7 bypasses ordinary source filter and selects alternate slots. Source mismatch or null slot reaches diagnostic trap.

FUNCTION.NAME: trap_lock_try
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: TRAPA 0x26: take the lock without waiting. r0 = 0 when taken or held by the same owner token, -1 otherwise. Owners 0x80..0xff never match.

FUNCTION.NAME: trap_lock_release
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: TRAPA 0x27 with VBR=0. Release owner-matched lock or transfer ownership to a waiter and enter scheduler context saving. r11 high bytes select record and owner.

FUNCTION.NAME: trap_lock_acquire
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: TRAPA 0x2a with VBR=0. TAS.B acquires an empty lock, and contention appends the current record to its waiter chain. Scratch r0/r10/r12/r13, direct return restores exception PC/SR/SP.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_extension_prepare
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Prepare disc collection: validate nonzero address/length, compare the address with the lead-out, clear decoded header and initialize destination/count state.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_extension_collect
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Copy sector payload between TRAPA 0x2a and TRAPA 0x27. Decode and process the entry only when no encoded bytes remain.

FUNCTION.NAME: expansion_extension_load
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Expansion loader for the MPEG card's code: length at 0x0e000000, data from +4. No local SR masking.

FUNCTION.NAME: task14_entry
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Final bootstrap task calls 0x1efc then spins at 0x1be6. It does not wait on a mailbox or poll a device register.

FUNCTION.NAME: trap_diagnostic
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: TRAPA 0x2b returns immediately. Callers pass a condition code in r0.

FUNCTION.NAME: trap_unused
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: TRAPA 0x2c returns at once.

FUNCTION.NAME: timer_reset
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Clear the software timer table and disable the compare-match interrupt, keeping the clock running.

FUNCTION.NAME: timer_overflow
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ITU4 overflow, vector 98. Increments the timer clock high part 0x0f00021c.

FUNCTION.NAME: timer_expiry
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ITU4 compare match A, vector 96. Posts every expired identifier with TRAPA 0x21, programs GRA4 for the next deadline or disables IMIA4, then reschedules through 0x102e.

FUNCTION.NAME: deferred_post_deliver
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ITU4 compare match B (vector 97): post the waiting messages and reschedule.

FUNCTION.NAME: timer_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: TRAPA 0x24 starts timer r11 with duration r10. Deadline = (0x0f00021c << 8 plus TCNT4 bits 15..8) + r10 - (6 * r10 >> 8). Up to four entries ordered by deadline. A new first entry programs GRA4 and enables IMIA4. A full table returns r0 = -1.

FUNCTION.NAME: timer_cancel
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: TRAPA 0x25 removes the r11 entry from the four-entry timer table at 0x0f000220 and returns r0 = 0, or -1 when absent. Removing the first entry reprograms ITU4 GRA or clears ITU4 IMIEA.

FUNCTION.NAME: deferred_post
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: TRAPA 0x2d: an interrupt handler's message waits at 0x0f000240 or 0x0f000244 until ITU4 compare match B, 0x7d counts later.

FUNCTION.NAME: task14_register_setup
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Clear the interface's command flags (0 to 0x0a000004), set IRQ6 priority 6 (0x0060 into 0x05ffff86), enable the command interrupt (0x0001 to 0x0a000008), write 0x0be1 to 0x0a00001e and publish NUL CDBLOCK in CR1..CR4 (0x0a000010..0x0a000017). Host commands raise IRQ6 from here on.

FUNCTION.NAME: irq6_command_entry
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: IRQ6 vector 70, raised by the interface chip when the host writes CR4: save the full task context, switch to the interrupt stack, clear the command flag at 0x0a000004, which releases IRQ6, read CR1..CR4 and dispatch.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_group_one
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: High nibble 1: commands 10 (play), 11 (seek) and 12 (scan) through the table at 0x2068.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_group_two
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: High nibble 2: command 20 (subcode) through the table at 0x208c.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_group_three
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: High nibble 3: commands 30 (set CD device connection), 31 (get it) and 32 (last partition reached).

FUNCTION.NAME: command_group_four
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: High nibble 4: commands 40..48 through the table at 0x20d0.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_group_five
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: High nibble 5: commands 50..56 through the table at 0x210c.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_group_six
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: High nibble 6: commands 60..67 through the table at 0x2140.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_group_seven
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: High nibble 7: commands 70..75 through the table at 0x2178.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_group_9
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Commands 90..9F. Rejected without bit 1 of 0x0f00027d (MPEG card present) and, except 93, without the card bit (bit 7 of 0x0f000892). 93 goes to 0xa050, the others to 0xf800.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_group_a
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Commands A0..AF, with the card bit needed for every command. AE goes to 0xa148, AF to 0xa0f0, the others to 0xf800.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_group_e
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Group E: e0..e2 through the three-entry table at 0x2288. e3..ef take the reject response.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_06_end_transfer
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 06: clear the data-transfer byte 0x0f00025b and end the transfer at 0x2568.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_data_gate
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Data commands 02, 20, 61, 63, 64 and 73: wait status while a transfer is open, otherwise the handler. A data transfer request opens one.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_ff
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Subcode0 echoes r2 twice, subcode1 returns startup diagnostic longwords, others return zero. Produces no message.

FUNCTION.NAME: transfer_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Start a transfer on DMA channel 1 under lock record 3: type 0 one RAM block to the host, type 2 a partition's sectors to the host, type 3 sectors from the host.

FUNCTION.NAME: dma1_end
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: DMA channel 1 end (vector 74): arm the next slot of a sector transfer, or mark the end, and return with RTE.

FUNCTION.NAME: transfer_end
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 06: stop DMA channel 1, copy words the host sent past the channel, answer the words transferred and post the end to the owner.

FUNCTION.NAME: task6_setup
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 6 initializes buffer metadata and local state, preserves diagnostic byte 0x0f00027d, updates device registers and waits on its internal mailbox. Setup posts no message.

FUNCTION.NAME: task6_class_dispatch
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 6 in drive states other than 0 and 17..22: class 4, 5, 6, 7 and 0x81 messages through the tables at 0x29c8, drive reports (class 0x83) through 0x3aa8 and the periodic status.

FUNCTION.NAME: toc_clear
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Fill 0x09000000..0x09000203 with ff, clear 0x09000210..0x09000217 and selected GBR-relative fields. Loops have fixed RAM endpoints, no external input.

FUNCTION.NAME: task6_states_17_18
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Drive states 17 and 18 (after status 81 and 80): Open Tray stages command 0c again in 17 and only clears busy in 18. Other host requests are kept and read the TOC with command 03, status 82 reads it, other reports pick the next drive state.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_toc_command
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Stage command 03 (read TOC) with the session in byte 1 and 0x0f000289.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_report_valid
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A report is taken only when its checksum matched and no staged command is still waiting for the report after the one that carried it.

FUNCTION.NAME: task6_states_19_21_22
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Drive states 19, 21 and 22 (TOC read and the seek after it): host requests are kept for later, status code 0 collects the TOC, code 9 ends it, code 4 in state 22 completes the seek.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_request_init
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 0x81 payload 0: clear the play settings and restart the other tasks through TRAPA 0x2e with interrupts masked.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_request_open
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 0x81 payload 2: the disc-gone reset and command 0c, drive state 17.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_request_play_track
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 0x81 payload 3: play range between track positions from 0x0f000264 and 0x0f000268.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_seek_command
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Stage command 09 (seek) to frame r0, also kept as the target 0x0f0002a0. Drive state 4, host status 4.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_request_play_resume
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 0x81 payload 5: play the current range, keeping the position when bit 7 of 0x0f00025d is set.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_read_command
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Stage command 06 (read) from target frame 0x0f0002a0. Drive state 4, host status 4 or 8.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_request_play_frame
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 0x81 payload 4: play range from a start frame and a frame count.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_request_seek_track
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 0x81 payload 6: seek to a track position.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_request_seek_frame
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 0x81 payload 7: seek to a frame.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_request_pause
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 0x81 payload 8: pause, or seek to the target when neither playing nor reading.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_pause_command
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Stage command 08 (pause). Drive state 5 or 10, host status 1.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_request_stop
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 0x81 payload 9: command 04, drive state 9, host status 2.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_standby
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 6 payload 0, the standby timer expired: command 05, drive state 8, host status 2.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_request_scan
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 0x81 payloads 10 and 11: scan forward or backward with command 0a or 0b.

FUNCTION.NAME: toc_track_frame
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Start frame of a track and the index and end for a track-form command.

FUNCTION.NAME: play_range_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: T = 1 when the target lies inside the play range 0x0f000298..0x0f00029c.

FUNCTION.NAME: play_target_store
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Normalize a frame or track position and store it as the target 0x0f0002a0.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_request_subcode
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 0x81 payloads 12 and 13: send the Q record or the TOC through 0x23ba.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_task5_retry
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 5 payload 0 from task 5: read again from 0x0f0002b4.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_task5_error
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 5 payload 2 from task 5: read error, status code 9, pause.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_task7_play
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 7 payload 0: read from request frame 0x0f0002bc, or from a default frame when it is 0.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_task7_pause
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 7 payload 1, sent after a disc header was recognized: pause (command 08).

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_task7_read
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 7 payload 2, a sector request: read (command 06) from request frame 0x0f0002bc, with the disc-authentication flag set.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_ring_seek_give_up
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Give-up after three failed ring seeks, or a read with no sector by its 150th report under authentication (post 07060003), and class 7 payload 3 at 0x3754: clear the request flags and seek back with command 09.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_task7_ring_seek
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 7 payload 4, an authentication seek: drive state 0x21, request frame 0x0f0002bc copied to target frame 0x0f0002a0, and command 02 to the target frame. Retries enter at 0x3788.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_buffer_free
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 4 payload 0: a read held for a full buffer continues from 0x0f0002c0.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_buffer_full
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 4 payload 1: hold the read and pause in drive state 10.

FUNCTION.NAME: toc_next_session
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Read the TOC of the next session announced by a B0 pointer.

FUNCTION.NAME: toc_collect
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Lead-in Q reports: counts them in 0x0f0002e0 (bit 3 of the status in 0x0f0002e4, otherwise 0x0f0002e8), stores track, A0, A1 and A2 entries, B0 session pointers, and seeks to the first frame when the TOC is complete.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_startup_seek_done
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: The seek after the TOC settled: drive state 11, 07060001 to task 7 and a kept host request dispatched again.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_report_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Report in a served drive state. Status code 8 stops the drive: task 7 is told when disc authentication owns the drive, then disc-gone or error handling. Other codes continue at 0x3b48.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_report_dispatch
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Drive report in task 6 by drive state 0x0f0002a5. State 0x21 (authentication seek) continues at 0x40d0.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_read_started
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Status code 3 in drive state 4: start sector delivery through task 5 (05060000 plus the read mode) and set drive state 12.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_seek_settled
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Status code 4 after a seek or pause: take the position and set drive state 11.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_state_6
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Playing: follow the position, read again after a jump, stop or repeat at the end of the play range.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_state_11
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Drive states 11 and 12: follow the position until the target is reached, seek again after a jump, end a read after 150 reports without a sector.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_target_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Target reached: pause in drive state 5, play on in drive state 6 or start a scan.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_pause_timer
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: In drive state 5, start standby timer 06060000 for word 0x0f000260 seconds (180 when 0).

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_report_seek
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Authentication seek report. At the target position 0x0f0002a0 with bit 2 of the status byte set, report word 0x0f0002d1 goes to 0x0f00027e, words 0x0f0002d6 and 0x0f0002d8 go to 0x0f0002ec and 0x0f0002ee, and 07060002 is posted to task 7. Words 0 and ffff seek again 206 frames further on, twice at most, and the third such report gives up at 0x3750.

FUNCTION.NAME: bcd_byte
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: BCD to binary, and BCD minutes, seconds and frames to a frame count at 0x41b6.

FUNCTION.NAME: toc_track_of_frame
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Track and offset of a frame from the TOC at 0x09000064, lead-out 0xaa.

FUNCTION.NAME: position_from_q
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Frame 0x0f000294 from the absolute time of a Q report.

FUNCTION.NAME: status_words_store
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Write the eight status bytes to the next of the buffers 0x0f00026c and 0x0f000274.

FUNCTION.NAME: task5_setup
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 5 initializes device registers and local queue state, takes two indices from the shared pool, and waits on its mailbox. Task 6's read requests, the decoder interrupt, the end of DMA channel 0, task 1 and command 30 post its messages.

FUNCTION.NAME: task5_message
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 5's message handling: DMA channel 0 end (0x84), sector pulses locked (0x80), task 6 requests (class 6), task 1 finished (class 1) and command 30 (0x81).

FUNCTION.NAME: task5_pulse_locked
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: The sector pulses are locked: start DMA channel 0 and prepare the next slot.

FUNCTION.NAME: task5_correction_done
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 1 finished a sector: complete the queued slots or send the next marked slot to task 1.

FUNCTION.NAME: task5_connect
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 30: connect CD device 0 to a filter or disconnect it.

FUNCTION.NAME: task5_stop
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Stop a read: DMA and decoder off, task 1 started again when correcting, queue flushed to two slots.

FUNCTION.NAME: task5_correction_request
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Send the oldest queued slot to task 1 (01050010).

FUNCTION.NAME: task5_queue_append
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Append r1 low-byte index unless ff. Head/tail/count at 0x0f000314, links at 0x0f000354. No validation, count wraps, and the caller must provide a detached tail link.

FUNCTION.NAME: sector_complete
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Decoder queue 0x0f000314: once more than two slots are queued, the head slot is delivered from CD device 0. While 0x0f000788 is not ff the CD device connections are cleared first, so the slot returns to the pool.

FUNCTION.NAME: task5_slot_prepare
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Take a pool slot for the next transfer and append it to the decoder queue.

FUNCTION.NAME: msf_to_fad
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: BCD MSF in r1 bits 31..8 to a frame address that includes the 150-frame lead.

FUNCTION.NAME: fad_to_bcd_msf
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Frame address to BCD MSF, the inverse of 0x4e0c, by restoring division against 45000, 4500, 750, 75, 10 and 1.

FUNCTION.NAME: buffer_pool_take
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Take head index from pool at 0x0f000348. Return r1=index or 255 when empty, r2=remaining count. Detach taken link and reset head/tail after last removal.

FUNCTION.NAME: pool_take_run
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Take a run of r1 slots from the free pool head.

FUNCTION.NAME: pool_return_run
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Append a run that ends at link ff to the free pool tail, then run the pool notification 0x51fa.

FUNCTION.NAME: sector_deliver
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Route slot r1 from source r2 through the filters at 0x5264, append it to the destination partition and post 07040000 to task 7 when notify bit 0 is set. Unrouted slots return to the pool.

FUNCTION.NAME: partition_slot
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Slot at position r2 of partition r1. Records 0x0f000600 + 6p hold head, tail, count, notify flags, cursor position and cursor slot. Links live at 0x0f000354.

FUNCTION.NAME: partition_release
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Return r3 slots from position r2 of partition r1 to the free pool at 0x0f000348.

FUNCTION.NAME: sector_route
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: CD device connection 0x0f000690, filter records 0x0f000420 + 16f (mode bit 6 frame range, bits 0..3 subheader fields, bit 4 inverts the subheader result), true output +2 and false output +3 of 0x0f0005a0 + 4f.

FUNCTION.NAME: filter_sources_clear
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Clear 24 connection ends through 0x54f0: filter sources from 0x5402, partition ends from 0x5408, false outputs from 0x540e.

FUNCTION.NAME: filter_clear
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Clear one filter record. No code reaches it.

FUNCTION.NAME: partition_empty
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Empty a partition into the free pool.

FUNCTION.NAME: connection_set
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Store a connection for CD devices (0x0f000690) or filters (0x0f0005a0).

FUNCTION.NAME: task4_message
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 4's messages: the filter settings 40, 42, 44 and 46, Reset Selector 48, Calculate Actual Size 52 and Execute FAD Search 55. Each ends with ESEL.

FUNCTION.NAME: task4_actual_size
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 52: words for the host by the get sector length, reading each sector's mode for length 0.

FUNCTION.NAME: task4_fad_search
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 55: the sector with the target frame address, or the nearest frame below it, from a position to the partition's end.

FUNCTION.NAME: dma0_end
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: DMA channel 0 end (vector 72): keep the decoder status, start the next transfer and post 05840010 to task 5 through TRAPA 0x2d.

FUNCTION.NAME: dma0_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Program DMA channel 0 for a prepared slot: slot + 12, 0x492 words, CHCR0 0x436d.

FUNCTION.NAME: irq7_decoder
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: IRQ7 (vector 71): decoder flags masked with their enables. Bit 4 the sector pulse, bit 5 the subcode.

FUNCTION.NAME: decoder_sector_pulse
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Lock on the sector pulse: two pulses one sector period apart start the decoder and post 05800012 to task 5.

FUNCTION.NAME: subcode_frame
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: IRQ7 flag 5: one subcode frame. Hunting counts two block starts (flag 6), locked counts frames by TCNT4 and stores the symbol in the ring. A completed pack posts 02800010 to task 2.

FUNCTION.NAME: itu4_time
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Time in ITU4 counts: the time high part and TCNT4.

FUNCTION.NAME: task2_message
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 2's messages: 02800010 decodes the completed packs, 02810000 sends the next pack to the host, 02030001 frees lock 3.

FUNCTION.NAME: subcode_q_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Q parity of symbols 0..3, one error corrected.

FUNCTION.NAME: subcode_p_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: P parity of the pack, up to two errors corrected.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_20_rw
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 20 type 1, Get Subcode R-W: WAIT without a pack, else the flags (bit 0 pack data error, bit 1 overrun), 12 words and 02810000 to task 2.

FUNCTION.NAME: task1_message_entry
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 1 waits for source/class 5 and low payload byte 0x10. Accepted work begins at 0x63f2, the sector correction.

FUNCTION.NAME: task1_correction
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 1's work for 01050010: correct slot 0x0f00071b and answer 05010011 with the result word 0x0f000718. Slot ff answers nothing.

FUNCTION.NAME: sector_correct
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: P, Q and P passes, then up to 5 Q and P pairs as 0x0f000262 allows.

FUNCTION.NAME: correct_p_pass
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: P pass: the 43 columns of 26 words, both bytes of each word.

FUNCTION.NAME: correct_q_pass
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Q pass: the 26 diagonals of 45 words, both bytes of each word.

FUNCTION.NAME: p_vector_single
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: P column 42, two lanes.

FUNCTION.NAME: p_vector_pair
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: P columns 2r9 and 2r9+1, four lanes, and the lane correction shared with column 42.

FUNCTION.NAME: q_vector_pair
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Q diagonals 2r9 and 2r9+1, four lanes, one long read serving both.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_61_63_get_sector_data
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Commands 61 and 63: busy check, request check 0x6dac, then 0c8100cc for task 12 with the data transfer request.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_62_delete_sector_data
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 62: request check 0x6dac, then 0c810062 for task 12. No gate and no busy check.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_64_put_sector_data
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 64: busy check, filter below 24, a count from 1 to the free slots, then 0c810064 for task 12 with the data transfer request.

FUNCTION.NAME: task12_dispatch
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 12 message dispatch: 61..64 from the host, class 3 at the end of a transfer.

FUNCTION.NAME: task12_request_set
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Keep a request at 0x0f00071c unless one is not yet taken (T = 1).

FUNCTION.NAME: task12_request_take
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Take the kept request into r12 and r13.

FUNCTION.NAME: task12_transfer_end
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: End of a sector transfer: return a get and delete's run to the pool, deliver a put's slots, free the transfer lock.

FUNCTION.NAME: task12_delete
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 62: connect 0x88 with the partition's end, release the slots to the pool.

FUNCTION.NAME: task12_get
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 61: connect 0x88 with the partition's end, find the first slot, step 0x21.

FUNCTION.NAME: task12_get_delete
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 63: connect 0x88 with the partition's end, unlink the slots, step 0x21.

FUNCTION.NAME: task12_put
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 64: connect 0x88 with the filter, take slots from the pool and clear their first 24 bytes, step 0x20.

FUNCTION.NAME: task12_transfer_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Start a type 3 (0x6d78) or type 2 (0x6d7e) transfer, tail-calling 0x23ba.

FUNCTION.NAME: sector_request_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Check a partition, position and count: ff rejects, 1 waits, 0 fits.

FUNCTION.NAME: get_sector_span
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Address and word count of a slot for the get sector length 0x0f0006d8.

FUNCTION.NAME: put_sector_span
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Address and word count of a slot for the put sector length 0x0f0006d9.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_65_66_copy_move
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Commands 65 and 66, Copy and Move Sector Data: destination filter, request check, free slots for 65, then 0d8100cc for task 13.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_67_copy_error
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 67, Get Copy Error: ff while task 13 works, 1 after an error, else 0.

FUNCTION.NAME: task13_message
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 13's messages: low byte 65 copies, 66 moves.

FUNCTION.NAME: task13_copy
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 65: copy each sector the destination filter's chain passes into a new slot, from device 0x89. ECPY at the end.

FUNCTION.NAME: task13_move
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 66: unlink the run and deliver its slots from device 0x89. ECPY at the end.

FUNCTION.NAME: task13_request_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Take the request and pair device 0x81 with the source partition's end and 0x89 with the destination filter.

FUNCTION.NAME: task13_connections_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Under the sector lock, T = 1 when either pair changed.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_40_set_filter_range
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 40, Set Filter Range: task 4 sets the start frame and count.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_46_set_filter_connection
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 46, Set Filter Connection: task 4 pairs the true output with a partition and the false output with another filter.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_48_reset_selector
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 48, Reset Selector: task 4 empties partitions and clears connections and filters by flag.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_50_get_buffer_size
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 50, Get Buffer Size: free slots (at most 200), 24 partitions, 200 sectors.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_60_set_sector_length
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 60: get sector length from the CR1 low byte, put sector length from the CR2 high byte, ff keeps. 0x40 to 0x0a00001e.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_54_get_sector_info
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 54, Get Sector Info: a sector's frame address and mode 2 subheader.

FUNCTION.NAME: buffer_command_post
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Record the request for task 4 and post 048100cc, or wait while one is not yet taken.

FUNCTION.NAME: buffer_command_answer
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Answers shared by the buffer commands: 0x91fe, reject, wait and status.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_disc_entry
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 7 initializes disc/header state and waits at 0x77c0. Header-parser exits also target that wait.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_timeout
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Expiry of timer 07070000 (class 7 payload 0). Disc states 2 and 3 store result 0, state 7 keeps the result and other states store 3. A stored result clears 0x0f000788, which blocks later sector delivery.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_drive_class
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 6 from task 6. Payload 2 continues the authentication seeks at 0x8952.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_abort
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Payload 7: EFLS with nothing in progress, otherwise state 4 and the end.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_sector_class
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 4 payload 0, a sector added to the partition: disc state 3 goes to the header scan 0x86d2, 6 to the sector checks 0x8a60, 7 to the extension read 0x8da8, 1 to 0x7954, and 4 releases sectors past the cursor.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_sector
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A sector added to partition f in disc state 1: dispatch on the step.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_transfer_class
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Class 3: payload 1 frees the transfer lock.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_transfer_end
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Free the transfer lock 03070000.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_volume_read
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Payload 0 without a root frame: read the volume descriptor, step 1.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_volume_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Step 1: 01 CD001 and the root directory record.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_root_read
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Read the root directory, step 2.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_directory_parse
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Parse directory records into the table, up to 256.

FUNCTION.NAME: file_id_window
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Place a file ID against the window: 0 in it (r2 the table index), 1 before it, 2 past it.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_change_directory
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Payload 1: read directory record 0x0f00076e, step 3.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_play
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Post 06070000 to task 6.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_info_one
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Payload 4: a type 0 transfer of one record.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_info_all
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Payload 5: a type 0 transfer of the window's records.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_read_directory
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Payload 2: move the window inside the table, or read the directory again or on.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_directory_skip
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Skip directory records up to the ID.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_read
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Payload 6: the file's frames through filter mode 0x41, step 5.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_end
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: End a request: EFLS, pause, the state after an abort.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_file_request
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Connect filter and partition f, set the filter record and the notification, post 06070000.

FUNCTION.NAME: task7_drive_stopped
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 7 class 6 payload 3, and payload 0 while busy: host status 6 gives result 0x11, disc state 7 keeps the result, a header scan with bit 3 of 0x0f0002a7 retries the next frame, other states give result 0 or 3.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 7 disc authentication request. Drive state 0, 6 or 7, or nonzero 0x0f00034b, gives result 0. A first track without the data bit gives result 1. A data track continues with a timer and sector reads at 0x85f0.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_data_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Data track: start timer 07070000 with duration 200000, connect filter p and partition p for the E0 CR3 partition p, choose frame 150 (or a TOC entry when bit 7 of 0x0f00025f is set), set header scan count 15 and disc state 3, then request sectors.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_header_scan
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Disc state 3 sector: take the sector at the cursor through 0x506c and parse it at 0x86ee.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_header_parse
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Sector-header state-machine block, r1=raw slot index. Reads payload +0xf8/+0xfc. Exits branch into shared firmware, without an RTS return or complete acceptance decision.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_seeks
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Disc state 5. TCNT4 selects zone z (0..12) and column c (0..69). Check positions 0x49124 + 1470 * (z + i) + 21 * c for passes 0..2, with exceptions for zones 0 and 12. Then four seeks: 0x3f435, 0x3fe51, the first position plus 0xdea, and the first position.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_seek_done
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Seek report (class 6 payload 2). Phases 1 and 3 need a report word within 18 or 20 of the one before. Phases 2 and 3 need report byte 1 >= byte 0 / 2 and byte 3 >= byte 2 / 2. A failure gives result 3 and closes delivery gate 0x0f000788.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_check_sector
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Disc state 6 sector: re-scramble it (0x8f1c) and interleave it (0x8f70) into a 294-frame stream. After the third sector, compare the stream from frame 196 with bitmap row zone + pass through 0x8e6e.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_classify
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Check score 0x0f000789 below 2 gives result 3 and closes the delivery gate. Otherwise result 4. A SEGASYSTEM header also sets ID gate 0x0f0002f9 (and 0x0f0002f8 with the 30-track flag), keeps the header ID at 0x0f0002f0 and stores 1 at 0x0f000786.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_result
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Store the result at 0x0f000787 and cancel timer 07070000. Branches arrive from the E0 request at 0x8510, the class 6 path at 0x8494, the header parser at 0x8782, and from 0x8986, 0x89ca and 0x8b74.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_release
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Outside disc state 2: disconnect CD device 0, clear the partition notify byte, return sectors past cursor 0x0f00078b to the pool and clear filter p.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_notify
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: After an E0 request, post 06070003 to task 6, restore the saved 04 settings, clear 0x0907adcb and busy flag 0x0f0007b0, write 0x0200 to 0x0a00001e and wait at 0x77c0.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_accepted
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Result 4 is stored on every path here (0x883c, 0x8ba0, 0x8bcc). Clear the expansion area through 0x1b5e and prepare a disc extension through 0x19ec. With an extension, disc state 7 reads its sectors from the header's extension address.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_sector_request
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Filter record 0x0f000420 + 16p gets a frame range (count 15, 3 or 0x0f000208 by disc state), partition notify bit 0 is set, CD device 0 is connected to filter p and 06070002 goes to task 6.

FUNCTION.NAME: disc_auth_extension_read
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Disc state 7 sector: collect it through 0x1a38. After the last sector has been decoded and checked the request completes with result 4 kept.

FUNCTION.NAME: logo_compare
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Compare 106 columns of interleaved bytes with one bitmap row: a8 where the bit is set, 59 where it is clear. A column of n bytes is good when at least (n - m) / 2 match, rounded down, with m 1 for a mask column, 2 for column 8 and 0 otherwise. 11 bad columns in a row stop the walk. 85 good columns add 1 to check score 0x0f000789.

FUNCTION.NAME: sector_rescramble
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Re-apply the ECMA-130 CD-ROM scrambler to raw sector bytes 12..2351, byte pairs swapped.

FUNCTION.NAME: frame_interleave
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Interleave 24-byte frames: each byte moves to its own position 3 to 108 frames later (offsets at 0x90d4).

FUNCTION.NAME: host_status_byte
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: The status byte of a response: BUSY while a command waits for its reply, ERROR after a read error, otherwise byte 0 of the last status buffer.

FUNCTION.NAME: response_transfer_request
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Status byte with the data transfer request bit 0x40.

FUNCTION.NAME: response_wait
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Cached response with the wait bit 0x80.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_01_hardware_info
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 01: hardware flag, version 1 and longword 0x0f0002fc (MPEG version, drive information, CD block revision). No message.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_02_toc
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 02: 0xcc words of TOC through task 6 payload 13. Wait status before the drive has a host status.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_03_session_info
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 03: session count and lead-out, or a session's first track and start. No message.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_04_initialize
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 04: standby word and bytes 0x0f000262/0x0f000263, then task 6 payload 0 (reset) or 8 (pause).

FUNCTION.NAME: command_05_open_tray
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Return message 06810002 and mark pending flag at task6 state+74. Response uses cached status. Task 6 handles the message later.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_10_play
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 10: play range from two track or frame positions, task 6 payload 3, 4 or 5.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_11_seek
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 11: task 6 payload 6 (track), 7 (frame), 8 (pause) or 9 (stop).

FUNCTION.NAME: command_12_scan
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 12: task 6 payload 10 (forward) or 11 (backward).

FUNCTION.NAME: command_20_subcode
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 20 type 0: 5 words of Q record through task 6 payload 12. Type 1 at 0x6354.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_70_change_directory
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 70: ffffff posts payload 0 (the root), other IDs in the window that name a directory payload 1.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_71_read_directory
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 71: posts payload 2, task 7 places the ID.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_72_get_file_system_scope
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 72: the window's file count, first ID and end flag.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_73_get_file_info
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 73, through the data-command gate: 6 words per file, payload 4 for one ID, 5 for ffffff.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_74_read_file
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 74: an ID in the window and an offset below its sectors post payload 6.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_75_abort_file
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Command 75: payload 7, or no message in state 4.

FUNCTION.NAME: file_command_state
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Shared ends of 70..75: state checks, post, reject, wait and the Get File Info response.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_link_strobe
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ITU3 input capture B (vector 93), one strobe per byte on TIOCB3. A frame is 13 SCI0 transfers: 11 command bytes and their inverted sum out, 11 report bytes and their inverted sum in, then an answer byte (00 for a matching sum). PB2 low starts or restarts a frame.

FUNCTION.NAME: drive_link_receive
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: SCI0 receive (vector 101) after the answer byte. The drive's final byte selects a new packet (00) or a repeat of the last one. Posts 06830000, the drive report, to task 6.

FUNCTION.NAME: extension_decode_wrapper
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Decoder wrapper. Helper code and constants occupy 0x9904..0x9ce3. Custom register ABI: r1 source, r2 destination, r3 byte length, r0 result (0 or -1). Default decompiler calling conventions are not authoritative for this routine. N = byte length >> 3. Rejects N < 2, processes N-1 eight-byte blocks and checks an XOR trailer after writing output.

FUNCTION.NAME: extension_decode_seed
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Seed count-derived state and code-as-data constants.

FUNCTION.NAME: extension_decode_edit_returns
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Mix state and insert 0x9b3c in saved return chain.

FUNCTION.NAME: extension_decode_final_mix
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Final stage assigns emitted r4/r5 at 0x9b30/0x9b32.

FUNCTION.NAME: extension_decode_inserted_continuation
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entered by RTS at 0x9bf6. No PR push, the saved wrapper return is already on stack.

FUNCTION.NAME: extension_decode_block
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Per-block entry. All 423 helper instructions execute for each valid block. Custom register/stack convention.

FUNCTION.NAME: extension_decode_output_mix
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Post-accumulation mixing, code constant from live PR+0x10.

FUNCTION.NAME: extension_decode_middle_mix
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Always runs and invokes the saved-return editor.

FUNCTION.NAME: extension_decode_accumulate_second
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Commit second accumulator and continue mixing.

FUNCTION.NAME: dma2_end
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: DMA channel 2 end (vector 76), the card's video data channel: clear IE, set bit 1 of 0x0f000892 and post 08890008 to task 8's entry 51.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_98
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 98 (CDC_MpGetTc), entry 8, replaced by the known cards: the frame bank, picture type and temporal reference in CR1 and CR2, the time code in CR3 and CR4, read from the card at 0x0a100022, from entry 37's record, or by the bank in 0x0a100006 from the records at 0x090752e4 and 0x090752f4. The wait path returns with r11 nonzero.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_99
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 99 (CDC_MpGetPts), entry 9: the longword 0x090752a4 in r13.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_9f
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 9F (CDC_MpGetPictSiz), entry 15: the picture size from the card register 0x0a100022 at indexes 0 and 1, 12 bits each. Waits with bit 3 of 0x0f000897.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a1
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A1 (CDC_MpSetWinFpos, CDC_MpSetWinFrat, CDC_MpSetWinDpos, CDC_MpSetWinDsiz, CDC_MpSetWinDofs), entry 17, replaced by the known cards: setting 0..4 from CR1's low byte, values from CR3 and CR4 into 0x0f00085a..0x0f000865, or for the display position and offset into 0x0907531c..0x09075323 and their sum into 0x0f000856. Doubled while bit 3 of 0x0f000854 is set. Bit 0 of CR2 writes 0x0f000856..0x0f000865 to 0x0a100002..0x0a100011.

FUNCTION.NAME: task8_mpeg_entry
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 8, the MPEG task, writes 0x7fff to MPEG card register 0x0a10001a, clears two RAM state regions and waits for a message at 0xa022.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_93
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 93. Rejected with ff000000 without a loaded extension. CR2 bit 0 set with the card bit clear posts 08810004 (task 8 activation at 0xa41c). Otherwise the card bit is cleared when bit 0 is clear, the channels stop and 08890000, 088a0000, 088c0000, 09810000 and 08810000 are posted. The response comes from entry 68.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_af
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: AF, without the expansion table: writes CR4 to a card register at 0x0a100000 or 0x0a180000 plus an even offset, or reads it.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_ae
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: AE, without the expansion table: the word the firmware keeps for a card register, from 0x0f000854 by offset or 0x0f000884.

FUNCTION.NAME: imib2_video_status
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ITU2 input capture B (vector 89), a falling edge of TIOCB2: three reads of 0x0a100000 ANDed into the video status word 0x0f000846, the MPEG interrupt flags with MPST, MPCM for an interval, entries 38..40, and work for task 8's entry 35 through 0x0f000896 and 088c0010.

FUNCTION.NAME: imib2_card_off
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Capture B with the card bit clear: count bits 4 and 5 of the status word clear in 0x0f00089e and 0x0f00089f.

FUNCTION.NAME: task8_mpeg_activate
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 8 payload 4: 0x7fff to 0x0a10001a, card channels start (0xa460), MPEG state and card bit cleared (0xa4d0), entry 34 (the ROM's 0xa4f0 sets the card bit), MPED, then entry 32.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_state_clear
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Clear 24 internal-RAM longwords and 83 buffer-RAM longwords in descending order. Returns with T=1, with no device reads, calls or message posting.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_state_activate
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 34 of the ROM table, from task 8's activation: entry 33, 0x8209 to 0x0a180008 and 0 to 0x0a180000, then 0x67818022 to 0x0f000890 (the card bit among it), -1 to 0x0f000850, 0x0101 to 0x0f000898..0x0f00089d and 20 to 0x090752e0.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_state_init
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 33 of the ROM table: MPEG state from 0x0f000854, then card registers 0x0a100020, 0x0a10001a, 0x0a100014, 0x0a100002 and 0x0a100000.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_94
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 94 (CDC_MpSetMode), entry 4, replaced by the known cards: the mode from CR1's low byte (2 rejected, 4 the sector buffer mode, bits 0 and 1 still picture and high definition), decode timing and output from CR2 into 0x0f000868 for 0x0a100014, the scan mode from CR3's high byte (bit 1 rejected) into bit 7 of 0x0f000891. Leaving the buffer mode runs entry 33.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_95
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 95 (CDC_MpPlay), entry 5: rebuilds the byte 0x0f000890 from CR1's low byte and CR2's bytes, and with CR4's low byte bit 5 of it and the decode bit, bit 0 of the word 0x0f000854 for 0x0a100000. Waits with bit 3 of 0x0f000892.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_96
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 96 (CDC_MpSetDec), entry 6, replaced by the known cards: the audio mute from CR1's low byte into 0x0f000884 for 0x0a180008, the pause (CR2) and freeze (CR4) as bits 2 and 3 of 0x0f000868, bits 0..2 and 4..6 of 0x0f000893 and intervals at 0x0f00088c and 0x0f000888. A new freeze runs entry 37.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_97
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 97 (CDC_MpOutDsync), entry 7, replaced by the known cards: in still picture the frame bank from CR2 into 0x0f000868, in states 4 and 5 entries 38 and 39 and a decode pulse on 0x0a100000, then 2 added to 0x0f000842 and MPCM. With VSYNC timing in the movie mode only the status response.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a0
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A0 (CDC_MpDisp), entry 16, replaced by the known cards, whose A0 can jump here: in still picture the frame bank from CR2 into 0x0f000868, then bit 0 of CR2's high byte clears bit 1 of 0x0f000854 for 0x0a100000, and clear sets it.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_countdown_a
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 38: count down 0x0f00088c. At 1 reload it from 0x0f00088e, set bit 2 of 0x0f000893 and bit 2 of 0x0f000868 for 0x0a100014.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_countdown_b
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 39: count down 0x0f000888. At 1 reload it from 0x0f00088a, set bit 6 of 0x0f000893 and bit 3 of 0x0f000868 for 0x0a100014.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_countdown_expired
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 40: clear the 0x0f000868 bits entries 38 and 39 set, running entry 37 for bit 6, and clear bits 2 and 6 of 0x0f000893.

FUNCTION.NAME: task8_card_events
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 8 offset 16, entry 35: the bits of 0x0f000896 call entries 43..45, 47..49 with entry 36, and 73..75, 85, 46, 41 and 42 by state, count intervals in 0x0f000842, then wait through entry 32.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_recover
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 41, the video part in state 6: once the video partition holds enough sectors, post 08890008, restore the state from 0x0f000898 and start decoding.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_recover
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 42, the audio part in state 6: once the audio partition holds 4 sectors, post 088a000c and restore the state from 0x0f000899.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_record_match
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 37: match the low 6 bits of 0x0a100006 against four records at 0x090752e4 and copy the match to 0x09075304.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_timestamp_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 36: r11 = 088a000c when 0x090752a8 with 0x090752ad is above 0x090752a4 with 0x090752ae.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_response_reject
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 66: status ff with the MPEG status.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_response_wait
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 67: the wait response's status byte with the MPEG status.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_response_status
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 68: the status response with the MPEG status from 0x0f00089c, 0x0f000891, 0x0f000842 and 0x0f000844.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_90
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 90, entry 0: the status response through entry 68.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_91
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 91, entry 1: the status byte with the longword 0x0f000848, which is cleared, in r12's low 24 bits.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_92
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 92, entry 2: CR1's low byte and CR2 to 0x0f00084c, then the status response through entry 68.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_9a
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 9A (CDC_MpSetCon), entry 10, replaced and called by the known cards: the audio (CR1, CR2) and video (CR3, CR4) connections, current or next by bit 0 of CR3's high byte, into 0x0907532c, 0x09075328, 0x09075334 and 0x09075330 with states to 2 and request bits in 0x09075388, or cuts. Posts 09810001 to task 9's card work loop.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_9d
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 9D (CDC_MpSetStm), entry 13, replaced by the known cards: stream modes, numbers and channels for audio (CR1, CR2) and video (CR3, CR4) into the records 9E returns, current or next by bit 0 of CR3's high byte.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_9b
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 9B (CDC_MpGetCon), entry 11: two connection records, current (0x0907532c, 0x09075328) or next (0x09075334, 0x09075330) by CR3's high byte, under masks. A current record's last byte becomes ff when its state 0x0f00089c or 0x0f00089d is 1, a next record's when its bit in 0x0f000894 is clear.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_9e
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 9E (CDC_MpGetStm), entry 14: two stream records, current (0x0907533c, 0x09075338) or next (0x09075344, 0x09075340) by CR3's high byte, under masks.

FUNCTION.NAME: dma3_end
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: DMA channel 3 end (vector 78), the card's audio data channel: clear IE, set bit 2 of 0x0f000892 and post 088a000c to task 8's entry 72.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_9c
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 9C (CDC_MpChgCon), entry 12: accepted parts of CR2 move 0x0f00089c or 0x0f00089d from 4 to 5, then entry 88, the status response and 08810014 to task 8.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_9c_apply
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 88, from 9C: parts with bit 0 clear call entry 58 or 59 (stopping DMA channel 2 or 3), clear their bit of 0x0f000894, return to state 1 and call entry 60. Then 0x0907537b = 1.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a2
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A2 (CDC_MpSetBcolor), entry 18: CR2 to 0x0a100012 and 0x0f000866.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a3
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A3 (CDC_MpSetFade), entry 19: two gains of -8..7 from CR2 into the high byte of 0x0f000854 and 0x0a100000, others rejected.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a4
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A4 (CDC_MpSetVeff), entry 20: the word 0x0f00086c for 0x0a10001c from CR2's low byte, CR3 and CR4, and bits 4..7 of 0x0f000854 for 0x0a100000 from CR2's high byte.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a5
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A5 (CDC_MpGetImg), entry 21, replaced by the known cards: rejected with output to VDP2, waits while bit 8 of 0x0a100000 is set, otherwise 0x00fe to 0x0a100016 and the display size's product in r12's low 24 bits. r13 stays 0x0a000000.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_exit_status
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Shared ends of 9C, A2..A4 and A5: entry 68 (0xb826), 67 (0xb834) or 66 (0xb842), each with r11 = 0.

FUNCTION.NAME: imia2_audio_error
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ITU2 input capture A (vector 88), a falling edge of TIOCA2: entry 56. Nothing is posted.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_error
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 56: clear IMFA, entry 57 with channel 3 paused, then the audio error bit 5 of 0x0f000845 and bit 20 of the MPEG interrupt flags, with MPST when masked in.

FUNCTION.NAME: audio_control_pulse
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 57: bit 14 of 0x0a180008 set and cleared again over the kept word 0x0f000884.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_channel_stop
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 58, from entry 88: stop DMA channel 2 with IE set and clear the video part's bytes, then 3 to 0x0a00000c.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_channel_stop
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 59, from entry 88: stop DMA channel 3 with IE set and clear the audio part's bytes.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_decode_pulse
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 61, no ROM caller: bit 0 of 0x0a100000 low for 8 loop passes and back.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_flag_toggle
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 60, from entry 88: toggle bit 1 of 0x0f000890.

FUNCTION.NAME: task9_message_wait
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 9 waits for a message before expansion processing at 0xba48.

FUNCTION.NAME: task9_message_dispatch
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 9 continuation. Payload 0 goes to 0xbbc6, 0x0f000892 bit7 set goes to 0xba5e and other requests continue at 0xbae8.

FUNCTION.NAME: task9_card_work
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 9 with the card bit set and a nonzero payload: bits 0..3 of 0x09075388 call entries 54, 53, 69 and 70, bits 0..3 of 0x09075389 jump to entries 78, 77, 80 and 79, which return through entry 76 (0xbad6). Repeats until no bit is set, then waits at 0xba46.

FUNCTION.NAME: task9_mpeg_checks
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Payload 1 returns to the wait. Payloads 2 and above run the five checks listed at 0xbc28 with r0 = 1. Entries 0 and 2 return zero, entries 1, 3 and 4 are the card checks at 0xbcc4, 0xbe7c and 0xbf04. Results collect in 0x0f0007b1 before 0xbb1e acts on them and on request byte 0x0907538a.

FUNCTION.NAME: task9_mpeg_action
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: After the card checks. A failed check clears the expansion for E0 through 0x1b5e (card status 0001) or sets status byte 1 for E2. Otherwise E0 runs the expansion loader 0x1b06 (status byte 0x0f0007ad = 2, whatever the result) and E2 expansion entry 86 through 0xf8e2 (status byte 0x0f0007ac = 3 for r13 = 0, else 2). Then the request byte and busy clear and 0x0800 (MPED) goes to 0x0a00001e.

FUNCTION.NAME: task9_mpeg_stop
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Task 9 payload 0 from 93: 3 to 0x0a00000c, 0 to 0x0a10001a. With the card bit set it posts 08090004 to task 8, otherwise clears the MPEG state and writes MPED.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_check_fail
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Returns -1. No reference in the ROM.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_id_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: No reference in the ROM. Expects ffffffff from 0x0a100008 and 0x0a10000a with ffff at 0x0a10001a, and SEGA with fffe.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_check_1
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Check 1: an MPEG-1 video sequence header of 18 words from 0x0907539c to 0x0a10001e on DMA channel 2, one word per falling edge of TIOCA1, the card's video data request (ITU1 capture A). Passes when TE is set after 0x500 loop passes.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_header_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: No reference in the ROM. Compares what 0x0a100022 returns for registers 3..0 with fields of check 1's header.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_check_3
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Check 3: 0x8209 to 0x0a180008, then four zero words to 0x0a180000 on DMA channel 3, one per falling edge of TIOCA0, the card's audio data request (ITU0 capture A). Passes when TE is set.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_check_4
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Check 4: fills the card memory behind 0x0a100030..0x0a100037, 512 blocks of 1024 bytes, with seed + block + byte offset, reads four words back from each quarter, then clears it without checking the clear.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_random
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Random word from the state at 0x090753e8 and TCNT4.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_ready_masked
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: No reference in the ROM. The ready poll with bit 7 of the word at 0x0f000868 cleared.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_ready
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Card ready: up to 33 polls of bit 0 of 0x0a100034, each after writing r11 to 0x0a100014.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_control_set
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: No reference in the ROM. Sets bit 7 of the word at 0x0f000868 and writes it to 0x0a100014.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_memory_fill
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Fill the card memory with seed + block + byte offset: per block the address (8-byte units) to 0x0a100030, 0xfe00 to 0x0a100032, 0xfffc to 0x0a100034, then 512 words to 0x0a100036.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_memory_compare
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Read four words at address r8 with 0xfa04 and compare them with the fill pattern for seed r0.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_memory_clear
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Fill the card memory with r0.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_rom_get
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Get MPEG ROM, ROM table entry 86, run by E2 through the stub 0xf8e2. Clears the page count 0x0f0007ae, then for each page from 0x0907538c to 0x09075390 takes a free slot, copies 2048 bytes from 0x0e005000 + 2048 * page between 24 and 280 cleared bytes and files the slot from CD device 3 through the filter. r13 = 0 after the last page, -1 without a free slot.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_rom_slot_take
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ROM table entry 81: the free pool head under the sector lock as task 9, kept at 0x0907539a, ff when the pool is empty.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_rom_page_address
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ROM table entry 84: the slot address for slot r1 and the page offset r2 << 11.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_rom_slot_clear
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ROM table entry 82: clear 24 or 280 bytes from r1 by bit 0 of r5.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_rom_page_copy
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ROM table entry 83: copy 2048 bytes from r2 to r1.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_rom_page_file
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ROM table entry 87: pair CD device 3 with the filter at 0x09075399, then deliver the slot at 0x0907539a from device 3, under the sector lock as task 9.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_e0_authenticate
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: E0 Authenticate Device. CR2 low byte 0 posts 07810008 to task 7 (disc) and 1 posts 09810002 to task 9 (MPEG). An accepted request keeps its message at 0x09075384 and sets busy flag 0x0f0007b0 until the task clears it.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_e2_mpeg_rom
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: E2 Get MPEG ROM. Requires nonzero 0x0f0002fd (a loaded expansion), filter at most 23, offset at most 0x7ff and offset plus count at most 0x800. Posts 09810004 to task 9.

FUNCTION.NAME: command_e1_auth_result
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: E1 Get Authentication Result. Subcode 0 returns word 0x0f000786 in CR2, whose low byte 0x0f000787 is the disc result. Subcode 1 returns words 0x0f0007ac and 0x0f0007ae in CR2 and CR4. No message.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a6
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A6 (CDC_MpSetImgPos, CDC_MpSetImgSiz), entry 22: position or size for bank 0..3, rounded down to even, at 0x0907539c + 8 * bank + 4 * selection.

FUNCTION.NAME: expansion_command_entry
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: MPEG commands 90..AF: entry n = (command & 0x3f) - 16 through the expansion table 0x0907b008.

FUNCTION.NAME: expansion_entry_32
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Stubs for entries 32..88 every four bytes: n into r0, then the jump through the expansion table 0x0907b008 + 4n.

FUNCTION.NAME: rom_entry_89
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Stubs for entries 89..97: the jump through the ROM table 0xf938 + 4n, firmware services for loaded code.

FUNCTION.NAME: expansion_table_jump
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Jump to entry r0 of the expansion table (0xf912) or the ROM table (0xf91a). r14 is kept, r0 is the target, everything else passes through.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_entry_point
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: The entry point. It merges the ROM table at 0xf938 into the entry table and returns. When the ROM table's version byte 0xf934 is greater than the card's version, every nonzero ROM entry replaces the card's. Otherwise each empty card entry takes the ROM's. The byte is 0 in every known CD-block revision, so the card's own entries stay.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_feed
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 51, task 8's message offset 8, which the DMA channel 2 end posts as 08890008. It sends the video part's next data to the card: under the sector lock it moves past the sector sent, looks for the next sector of the video partition that holds video data and starts DMA channel 2 on it. It ends by clearing bit 1 of 0x0f000892, the channel's end, and jumping to entry 32, task 8's wait. The partition is the byte 0x0907532b, the position in it the word 0x09075324. The device end 0x8d stands for the video decoder in the buffer's connections.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_packet_header
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 52, which entries 51 and 72 and task 9's card work call: read an MPEG-1 packet header from r3, which points at the packet length after the start code. It returns r3 at the packet's data and r5 its length in bytes, 0 when nothing is left. In r8 bit 0 marks a STD buffer size, then in r6 in 2048-byte units, bit 1 a PTS, then its low 32 bits in r7 and its bit 32 in bit 31 of r8, and bit 2 a header byte that fits none of the forms. Changes r0 to r2 and r10.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_pts_read
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Read an MPEG timestamp of 5 bytes from r3: r2 = its low 32 bits, r1 = the first byte shifted right 3, so bit 0 of r1 is bit 32. The marker bits drop out. Entry 52 jumps here with its return address in r10.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_picture_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 43, which entry 35 calls for status bit 11, before entry 44 or 45. Status bit 11 is a picture start: the entry flags Sega's PSTRT (picture start detected) and keeps the new picture's word 6 and time code, the last picture's for the frame bank it went to. It also flags GSTRT (GOP start detected) for status bit 12 and SQSTRT (sequence start detected) for status bit 14, and takes the picture rate from the card's word 1. The records 0x090752e4 + 4k, one for each frame bank k, hold bit 7 for the bank the last picture went to, a GOP count and word 6, the picture type and temporal reference. The longwords 0x090752f4 + 4k hold the time codes. 0x09075314 and 0x09075318 hold the latest picture's, the byte 0x09075310 the GOP count, 0x09075311 and 0x09075313 bits 8 to 11 of 0x0a100006.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_transfer_picture_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 44, which entry 35 calls for status bit 11 (bit 0 of 0x0f000896) in the video state 4, transfer, after entry 43. It keeps the stream's first I picture for entry 48 and pulses the decode bit in the movie mode.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_switch_picture_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 45, which entry 35 calls for status bit 11 in the video state 5, switch, after entry 43. With bit 0 of 0x0f000892 clear it jumps to entry 63, the step of a change 9C asked for. Bit 0 is set by entry 51 and cleared by entry 49. Otherwise it waits for the decode stopped bit, bit 0 of 0x0f000891, which a sequence end sets, and keeps the old stream's last picture and the new stream's first for entry 49.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_decode_error_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 50, which entry 75 calls through the stub 0xf852. It calls 0x0907f728, which also serves entries 43 and 47. In the movie mode with bit 15 of the word 0x0f000850 clear, the capture B status bit for Sega's VDERR, that routine writes the word 0x0f00086a without bit 13 to 0x0a10001a and clears and restores the decode bit.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_transfer_interval
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 35's step for the video state 4, transfer, at an interval, through the pointer at 0x0907c794. With a current video connection (bit 3 of 0x0f000890), the decode stopped bit (bit 0 of 0x0f000891) and the movie mode (bit 6 of the word 0x0f000868), it clears the decode bit, bit 0 of the word 0x0f000854, and writes the word to 0x0a100000, with bit 1 of 0x0f000897 set around it.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_switch_interval
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 46, which entry 35 calls at an interval in the video state 5, switch. With bit 0 of 0x0f000892 clear it jumps to entry 65, the step of a change 9C asked for. Otherwise, once bit 1 of 0x09075350 and bit 5 of 0x0907534c are set, the video part moves to its next connection.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_picture_update
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 47, which entry 35 calls for status bit 6, Sega's picture updated, before entry 48 or 49. It keeps bits 8 to 11 of 0x0a100006 for entry 43, clears Sega's first and last picture bits and adds one picture's duration to the second video timestamp. In an interlaced scan it also counts the pictures and writes fffb to 0x0a100018 at a count that depends on the picture rate.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_transfer_picture_update
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 48, which entry 35 calls for status bit 6, Sega's picture updated, in the video state 4, transfer, after entry 47. Once the I picture entry 44 kept is shown it marks the output start, sets the video timestamp and starts the audio of a synchronized play. Every call then corrects the audio against the video.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_switch_picture_update
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 49, which entry 35 calls for status bit 6 in the video state 5, switch, after entry 47. It marks the old stream's last picture shown and ends the switch when the new stream's first picture is shown. With bit 0 of 0x0f000892 clear it jumps to entry 62, the step of a change 9C asked for.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_state_init
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 33, over the ROM's 0xa52c. Entry 34 calls it at the card's activation and 94 when it leaves the sector buffer mode. From 0x0f000854: 0x88fe0096, 0x002602c0, the word 0x01e0 at +8, the words 1 at +14 and +16, 0xfff3fffe at +20 and 0xffffd7af at +24. The ROM stores 0xfff3ff7e and 0xffff47af at +20 and +24.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_94
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 94, Set MPEG Mode, entry 4, over the ROM's 0xa5dc. As the ROM's handler it takes the mode from CR1's low byte, the decode timing from CR2's high byte, the output from CR2's low byte and the scan mode from CR3's high byte, bit 7 of each leaving that setting alone. The comments below name where it differs.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_delay
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A delay: r0 counts from 0 to 16. 97 runs it around its decode bit pulse. Changes r0 and T only.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_97
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 97, Send Decode Sync, entry 7, over the ROM's 0xa98c. A frame bank in CR2's low bits for a still picture mode. GBR = 0x0f000890 for the first test.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_ab_ad
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: AB, AC and AD, entries 27 to 29. r12 and r13 = ffffffff, so CR1 to CR4 answer ffff, without the status byte or the MPEG status. r11 = 0: nothing is posted.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_record_keep
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 37, over the ROM's 0xae2c. 96 calls it when it starts a freeze, and entry 40 when it freezes again after entry 39's countdown. The bank shown is bits 6 and 7 of the card register 0x0a100006. Its longword 0x090752f4 + 4k goes to 0x09075304 and the low word of its record 0x090752e4 + 4k to the word 0x0907530c. The ROM looks the register's low 6 bits up among the records instead, stores ffff on no match and keeps the register's low byte at 0x09075312.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_card_events
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 35, over the ROM's 0xab78, task 8's message offset 16, which capture B posts as 088c0010. It takes the bits of 0x0f000896 in order as the ROM's does: bit 0 (status bit 11) calls entry 43, then 44 or 45, bit 1 (status bit 6) entry 47, then 48 or 49 and entry 36, and bit 2 (an interval) entry 75, a step for the video state and 73, 85 or 42 for the audio state. It ends by jumping to entry 32, task 8's wait. It differs from the ROM's in two ways. At an interval the video state picks its step from the table 0x0907c78c, which adds the countdowns of the state 1 and the step 0x0907bca8 of the state 4 to the ROM's 74, 46 and 41. And the bit the ROM keeps in bit 7 of 0x0f000890, set in a synchronized play with both states 4 while paused, is bit 7 of 0x0f000893 here, which entry 72 reads too. Byte changes are single or.b and and.b instructions on GBR = 0x0f000890.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a0
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A0, Display Picture, entry 16. Bit 1 of 0x0f000891 gives the wait response through entry 67. Otherwise it jumps to the ROM's handler, ROM table entry 16 (0xaa64), which returns to the caller.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_stopped_interval
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 35's step for the video state 1 at an interval, through the pointer at 0x0907c78c. In the movie mode with VSYNC timing, outside the sector buffer mode (bits 7, 6 and 0 of the word 0x0f000868 set), bit 0 of 0x0f000893 without bit 2 calls entry 38 through the stub 0xf822, and bit 4 without bit 6 entry 39 through 0xf826. GBR is left at 0x0f000890.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_recover
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 42, over the ROM's 0xadb8. Entry 35 calls it for the audio state 0x0f00089d at 6, recovery. It first calls the ROM's entry 42 through the ROM table, which ends the recovery once the audio partition holds 4 sectors and leaves the count in r10.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_timestamp_check
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 36, over the ROM's 0xae68, called by entry 35. r11 = 088a000c when the byte 0x090752ae (sign-extended) over the word 0x090752a8 is above the byte 0x090752ad over the word 0x090752a4, unsigned, otherwise 0. The ROM pairs the bytes the other way round: 0x090752ad over 0x090752a8 against 0x090752ae over 0x090752a4.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_96
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 96, Set Decoding Method, entry 6. In the video state 6 (recovery), a pause (CR2) or a freeze (CR4) other than ffff gives the wait response through entry 67, as Sega documents for that state. Otherwise it jumps to the ROM's handler, ROM table entry 6 (0xa824).

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_9a
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 9A, Set MPEG Connection, entry 10. Any of bits 1 to 3 of 0x0f000892 gives the wait response through entry 67. Otherwise it calls the ROM's handler, ROM table entry 10 (0xaf64), and returns its answer and its r11, the message 09810001 to task 9 when it accepted the connection. For the next connections (bit 0 of CR3's high byte) it writes the current video record 0x09075328 back afterwards when it was not 0, so bit 6 of 0x0907532a, which the ROM's handler clears there, stays.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_recover
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 41, over the ROM's 0xad40. Entry 35 calls it for the video state 0x0f00089c at 6, recovery. As the ROM's entry: the word 0x0f000868 without bits 2 and 3 goes to 0x0a100014, the kept word unchanged, and the threshold r1 is 1, or the word 0x090752e0 with bit 2 of 0x0f000890 set.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_feed
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 72, task 8's message offset 12, which the DMA channel 3 end posts as 088a000c, as does entry 35 while the audio waits for the video. It checks the audio register 0x0a180008, then sends the audio part's next data to the card as entry 51 does for the video, through DMA channel 3 to 0x0a180000, or to 0x0a180002 for a single byte. At the stream's end it switches to the next connection, and it takes an audio change that entry 64 left. It ends by clearing bit 2 of 0x0f000892, the channel's end, and jumping to entry 32. The partition is the byte 0x0907532f, the position in it the word 0x09075326. The device end 0x8c stands for the audio decoder. Unlike entry 51 it takes the sector lock only around each buffer call.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_sector_flags
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: For entry 72, with r1 at an audio sector: the submode's trigger bit (bit 4 of +18) flags bit 14, Sega's ATRG, and its EOR bit (bit 0) flags bit 15, AEOR, each with MPST when its mask bit is set. GBR is left at r1.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_interval_status
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 75, which entry 35 calls first at an interval. It sets the statuses 90 reports and makes the next connections task 9 prepared wait for their switch, then jumps to entry 50, which returns to entry 35.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_prepare_interval
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 74, which entry 35 calls at an interval in the video state 3, the second preparation, through its table at 0x0907c790. It starts the video transfer.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_prepare_delay
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A delay: r0 counts from 0 to 8. Entry 74's own copy of 0x0907da0e. Changes r0 and T only.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_prepare_interval
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 73, which entry 35 calls at an interval in the audio state 3, the second preparation. It starts the audio transfer, or in a synchronized play marks the audio ready for entry 48.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_change_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 64, task 8's message offset 20, which 9C posts as 08810014 after entry 88. It starts the change 9C asked for with the bytes 9C kept, CR2 at 0x09075374 and CR3 at 0x09075376: the low bytes for the video part, the high bytes for the audio part, bit 0 of CR2 for a change, bit 7 for no action. It ends by clearing 0x0907537b, so 9C no longer waits, and jumping to entry 32.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_change_picture_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 63, which entry 45 jumps to for status bit 11 in the video state 5 while bit 0 of 0x0f000892 is clear. It runs the steps of a video change 9C asked for, kept in 0x09075378 by entries 64, 63, 65 and 62.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_switch_interval
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 85, which entry 35 calls at an interval in the audio state 5, switch. With bit 0 of 0x09075379, set by entry 64 for an audio change, and the next audio connection waiting (bit 7 of 0x0907534c), the audio part moves to it through 0x0907d912, 0x09075379 is cleared and the audio state becomes 4.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_change_interval
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 65, which entry 46 jumps to at an interval in the video state 5 while bit 0 of 0x0f000892 is clear. In the movie mode with the decode stopped bit (bit 0 of 0x0f000891) set it pulses the decode bit through entry 61. With 1 in 0x09075378 and the next video connection waiting (bit 5 of 0x0907534c), 0x09075378 becomes 4 and the video part moves to it through 0x0907d85a.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_change_picture_update
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 62, which entry 49 jumps to for status bit 6 in the video state 5 while bit 0 of 0x0f000892 is clear. With 8 in 0x09075378 it ends the video change once the card shows the I picture entry 63 kept: in the movie mode the card's picture number, the low 6 bits of 0x0a100006, must equal the byte 0x0907537a.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_next_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Move the video part to its next connection and start its DMA. Entries 63, 64 and 65 call it after storing 4 in 0x09075378.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_channel_stop
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 58, over the ROM's 0xb95c. The card's 88 calls it for the video part, and entry 63 at a change. As the ROM's it stops DMA channel 2 (DE and TE cleared, IE set), clears the byte 0x0907535c, bits 3 and 4 of 0x0f000890, bit 1 of 0x0f000892 and the byte 0x09075351, and writes 3 to 0x0a00000c. With bit 3 of 0x0f000890 set it first calls entry 60. The ROM's also clears the longword 0x09075314.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_next_start
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Move the audio part to its next connection and start its DMA. Entries 64 and 85 call it.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_register_18_ffdf
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Write ffdf to the card register 0x0a100018. Entries 63 and 64 call it after a VBV clear in the movie mode.

FUNCTION.NAME: decode_bit_clear
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Clear the decode bit, bit 0 of the word 0x0f000854, and write the word to 0x0a100000, with bit 1 of 0x0f000897 set around it.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_vbv_clear
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Sega's VBV clear: write the word 0x0f00086a without bits 12 and 13 to 0x0a10001a twice, five nops apart, with bit 2 of 0x0f000897 set around it. The kept word does not change.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_flag_toggle
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 60, over the ROM's 0xb9ec: toggle bit 1 of 0x0f000890, in one xor.b where the ROM tests and branches.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_short_delay
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A delay: r0 counts from 0 to 8. Changes r0 and T only.

FUNCTION.NAME: decode_bit_set
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Set the decode bit, bit 0 of the word 0x0f000854, and write the word to 0x0a100000, with bit 1 of 0x0f000897 set around it.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a5
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A5, Get Image, entry 21, over the ROM's 0xb7ca. Bit 1 of the word 0x0f000868 set, output to VDP2, gives the reject response through entry 66.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_9c_apply
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 88, over the ROM's 0xb5d2, which 9C calls after moving each accepted part to state 5. CR2 is kept at 0x09075374 and CR3 at 0x09075376. The low bytes are the video part, the high bytes the audio part, and a byte with bit 7 set leaves its part alone. Bit 0 clear, Sega's cut, runs as in the ROM: entry 58 or 59, bit 0 or 4 of 0x0f000894 cleared, the state 1 and entry 60. Bit 0 set, Sega's change, where the ROM does nothing, stops the part's DMA at once for an immediate clear in CR3, Sega's clear mode. Entry 64 goes on with the change. It ends by setting 0x0907537b, as the ROM's does.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_sector_read_job
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 80, the job of A9 (Sega's CDC_MpReadSct), bit 2 of 0x09075389, which task 9's card work loop jumps to. Each pass reads the next sector of the MPEG sector buffer from the card's memory into a free slot and files it through the job's filter with entry 87, as Get MPEG ROM files a page, then jumps to entry 76. The job is at 0x0907538c: the next MPEG sector, the end at +4 (the first sector plus the count), the count at +8 and the filter at +12.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_sector_write_job
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 79, the job of AA (Sega's CDC_MpWriteSct), bit 3 of 0x09075389. Each pass takes a sector out of the buffer partition, writes its data to the next sector of the MPEG sector buffer in the card's memory and returns the slot to the pool, then jumps to entry 76. As Sega documents, the sectors leave the partition. The job is at 0x0907538c as A9's: the next MPEG sector, the end at +4 (256 for a count of ffff), the count at +8, the partition's position at +10 (ffff for its last sector) and the partition at +12.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a9
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A9, Sega's CDC_MpReadSct, entry 25: read sectors of the MPEG sector buffer through a filter, CR1's low byte (0 to 23), in task 9. CR3 is the first MPEG sector, 0 to 255, and CR4 the count, the first sector plus the count at most 256. It needs the sector buffer mode (bit 6 of 0x0f000892) and no card job pending in 0x09075389. Anything else gives the reject response.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_aa
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: AA, Sega's CDC_MpWriteSct, entry 26: write sectors of a buffer partition, CR1's low byte (0 to 23), into the MPEG sector buffer in task 9. CR2 is the partition's first sector, below 199 or ffff for its last, CR3 the first MPEG sector, 0 to 255, and CR4 the count, ffff for up to the end at 256. The same checks and job as A9, with CR2 kept too.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_image_read_job
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 78, the job of A7 (Sega's CDC_MpReadImg), bit 0 of 0x09075389. Each pass fills a free slot with 2048 pixels of the frame bank's image window, one byte each, and files it through the plane's filter with entry 87, then jumps to entry 76. The Y plane's rows come first, then the Cr and Cb planes at half the width and height, and a plane's last sector ends in zeros. The parameters are at 0x090753c4: the Y, Cr and Cb filters, the bank (+3), the resolution (+5, 1 normal, 0 high definition) and the window's left, top, right and bottom (+6 to +12). The byte 0x090753d2 is the plane, 0 to 2, and the words 0x090753d4 and 0x090753d6 the next pixel's x and y.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_image_write_job
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 77, the job of A8 (Sega's CDC_MpWriteImg), bit 1 of 0x09075389. Each pass takes a sector from the partition of a plane and writes its bytes into the frame bank's image window as pixels, then jumps to entry 76. The Y, Cr and Cb planes come from their own partitions, the chroma planes at half the width and height. With clear mode 0 the sectors stay in their partitions, with 1 they leave them. The parameters are A7's at 0x090753c4, with the partitions for the filters and the clear mode at +4. At 0x090753d8: a bit for each plane still to write, the sectors each plane used (+1 to +3), and each plane's next pixel, x and y at +4 + 4 * plane.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a7
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A7, Sega's CDC_MpReadImg, entry 23: read the image window of a frame bank into buffer partitions through three filters, in task 9. CR3's low byte, which A8 uses as its clear mode, is cleared first, then the image helper checks and keeps the parameters. A failure gives the reject response.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a8
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A8, Sega's CDC_MpWriteImg, entry 24: write three buffer partitions into the image window of a frame bank, in task 9. CR3's low byte is the clear mode, 0 or 1. The image helper checks and keeps the parameters, and a failure gives the reject response.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_image_window
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: The image helper of A7 and A8. r0 = 0 when it takes the parameters, -1 otherwise. It needs no card job pending in 0x09075389, a still picture mode (bit 6 of the word 0x0f000868 clear) and not the sector buffer mode (bit 6 of 0x0f000892 clear).
