Sega documents both functions for the still picture mode only.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_memory_ready
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Wait for the card's memory: up to 32 times read 0x0a100034. Bit 0 set, ready, reads it twice more and returns r0 = 0. Otherwise the try writes ffff to 0x0a100034 and writes the word read from 0x0a100036 back to it. r0 = -1 when it never comes. GBR = 0x0a100000. Changes r11.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_memory_wait
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Up to 112 reads of 0x0a100034 for bit 0, ready: r0 = 0 when it comes, -1 otherwise. Changes r11.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_memory_open
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Open the card's memory for the image jobs. The card's video data request is kept from DMA channel 2: with IMIEA, bit 0 of TIER1, cleared and a wait of 0x5000 passes, DE in CHCR2 is cleared and TSR1 kept at 0x0907538b. Then bit 7 of the word 0x0f000868 is cleared and the word written to 0x0a100014, IMIEA set again, and up to 33 times 0x0a100034 is read for ready as 0x0907e71c does. r0 = 0 ready, -1 otherwise.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_memory_close
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Close the card's memory after an image job: address 0, fa04 to 0x0a100032, fffc to 0x0a100034 and 81 reads of 0x0a100036, then ready through 0x0907e71c. Bit 7 of the word 0x0f000868 is set and the word written to 0x0a100014. DMA channel 2 runs on: with IMIEA cleared, DE is set and a capture that came meanwhile cleared, unless one was pending when the memory opened. IMIEA is set again and 0x0907538b cleared. r0 = 0.

FUNCTION.NAME: card_data_request_wait
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Wait for the card's video data request: up to r0 reads of TSR1 for IMFA, ITU1's capture of TIOCA1, then clear it. r0 = 0 when it came, -1 otherwise. GBR = 0x0a100000 after.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_frame_address
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: The card memory address of the pixel x = r10, y = r11 of plane r6 (0 Y, 1 Cr, 2 Cb) in bank r7, with r5 = 1 for the normal resolution and 0 for high definition. The memory is 512 rows of 1024 bytes. Returns r7 the byte, r8 its 8-byte group and r9 the byte in the group. Changes r3 and r4.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_job_slot_release
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Under the sector lock as task 9, return the slot at 0x0907539a to the pool through entry 97.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_prepare
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 54, task 9's card work for bit 0 of 0x09075388, a new video connection. Each call looks at the sector at the video position and returns. It skips sectors until one holds the stream's start, keeps its data for entry 74's DMA channel 2, puts the video in state 3, the second preparation, and clears bit 0. The start is the first video packet with a PTS, or with Sega's IGPTS (bit 3 of the mode) the first one. With Sega's picture search (bit 7 of the layer byte 0x0907532a) it is the first sequence header after it, or a GOP header after more than 64 pictures, and the video timestamp grows by the pictures counted. With the search's audio bit as well (bit 6, Sega's CDC_MPSRCH_AV) audio sectors older than the video's are dropped and entry 71 prepares the audio. The byte 0x0907535d holds the progress: bit 0 a STD buffer size taken, bit 2 a PTS, bit 3 data, bit 4 the stream's end in this sector, bit 5 the start found, bit 6 a video packet in this sector.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_sector_skip
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Move past the sector at the video position: with bit 2 of the mode, Sega's DEL, release it through entry 93 under the sector lock as task 9, otherwise add 1 to the position.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_sector_skip
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: The same for the audio: the sector at 0x09075326 with the audio mode and partition.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_start_code_find
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 55, which entry 54 calls: find the start code prefix 000001 in r5 bytes from r3. It compares each window from its last byte and moves on by what the byte allows. r0 = 0 with r3 at the prefix and r5 the bytes from there, -1 when there is none. Changes r1, r2 and r6 to r9.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_video_next_prepare
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 53, task 9's card work for bit 1 of 0x09075388, a new next video connection. Each call looks at the sector at the next video position and returns. The first video packet with a PTS, or a sector without a pack, is kept for the switch: its data at 0x090752c4 and 0x090752da, its PTS as the next video timestamp 0x090752b8 over 0x090752b4. Bit 1 of 0x0907534c then marks the connection prepared for entry 75, and bit 1 is cleared. Other sectors are skipped. The byte 0x0907535e holds bit 2 for a PTS and bit 3 for data.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_98
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 98, Get MPEG Timecode, entry 8, over the ROM's 0x9d44. The answer as the ROM's: the frame bank in CR1's low byte, the picture type and temporal reference in CR2's high and low bytes, and the time code in CR3 and CR4.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_a1
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: A1, Set Window, entry 17, over the ROM's 0x9ed8. CR1's low byte selects the window setting 0 to 4, CR3 and CR4 are its x and y, and bit 0 of CR2's low byte writes the window words to the card. GBR = 0x0f000854.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_decode_error_recover
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entries 43, 47 and 50 call it first. In the movie mode (bit 6 of the word 0x0f000868) with bit 15 of the status word 0x0f000850 clear, the capture B status bit for Sega's VDERR (video decode error): with bit 2 of 0x0f000897 set around it, the word 0x0f00086a without bit 13 goes to 0x0a10001a, the kept word unchanged. Then with bit 1 of 0x0f000897 set around it the decode bit, bit 0 of the word 0x0f000854, is cleared and the word written to 0x0a100000, then set to bit 5 of 0x0f000890 inverted, 95's decode switch, and written again.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_prepare_with_video
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 71, entry 54's audio step for a picture search with audio. It runs entry 69's steps with bit 1 of 0x0f000895 set, which changes three things: a sector it cannot use stays for entry 54 to drop, a packet without a PTS is taken too, and no state is set. It returns by jumping to the address at 0x0907537c. r10 tells what it found: bit 0 no sector, bit 1 a timestamp taken, bit 2 an audio cut, bit 3 a PTS, bit 4 an audio packet.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_prepare
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 69, task 9's card work for bit 2 of 0x09075388, a new audio connection. Each call looks at the sector at the audio position and returns. The first audio packet with a PTS is kept for entry 73's DMA channel 3: the source at 0x090752c8, the count at 0x090752dc and the destination at 0x090752d0. The audio state becomes 3 and bit 2 is cleared. Other sectors are skipped.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_audio_next_prepare
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Entry 70, task 9's card work for bit 3 of 0x09075388, a new next audio connection. As entry 69 with the next audio's records, it keeps the first audio packet with a PTS for the switch: its data at 0x090752cc, 0x090752de and 0x090752d4, its PTS less 783 as the next audio timestamp 0x090752b9 over 0x090752bc, the odd byte bits in bits 0 and 1 of 0x09075370 and the stream's end in bit 3. Bit 3 of 0x0907534c then marks the connection prepared for entry 75, and bit 3 is cleared. It pairs no device end.

FUNCTION.NAME: mpeg_command_9d
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: 9D, Set MPEG Stream, entry 13, over the ROM's 0xb2c4. The audio stream's mode is CR1's low byte with its stream and channel numbers in CR2, the video stream's CR3's low byte and CR4. Bit 0 of CR3's high byte selects the next streams. A mode with bit 7 set, Sega's no change, leaves its part alone throughout.
